speaker: Flo
text: From food stalls to shopping malls, almost every place I stopped by in this corner of Beijing accepted mobile payment. When making a purchase, all I needed to do was tap on the phone, scan the QR code, and make the payment in a second or two. Mobile payment has really changed the way of life in China.
